placements.why: The envelope's content is a test-sample artifact whose entire purpose is evidentiary: it exists to prove a defect pattern is reproduced and that baseline correctness holds. Nothing in the supplied strata (currently empty) or narrative structure covers organizational content of this kind — proof/verification artifacts distinct from Strategy, Product, or Architecture design work. No existing category is even close, so this is a NEW foundational strata mint with no forced parent, matching the pattern of a top-level organizational category (Proof) that other test/verification envelopes can nest under going forward.
placements.title: Evidence artifacts as their own organizational tier
placements.frame: What test, reproduction, or validation artifact substantiates that a system meets its stated correctness contract?

placements.title: Test fidelity to real production failures, not synthetic ones
placements.frame: Does this test artifact reproduce a documented production failure pattern faithfully, and does it still satisfy the system's baseline correctness contract (no crash, valid output) while doing so?
placements.why: src-1 asserts the sample reproduces a specific, named production failure pattern (heading missing an id field); src-2 states the correctness floor the reproduction must still clear (no crash, valid slug). Together they name a recurring subject beyond this one artifact — the practice of anchoring test cases to observed production defects while holding a baseline contract — which is exactly the kind of theme future 'Sample Memory' phases (Phase 3, 4, ...) will keep feeding, not a one-time fact. No existing narrative leaf exists in this repo (structure is empty) and nothing in the surfaced map (Strategy/Decision content about consulting methodology) is even a loose fit, so this is a standalone mint under the newly-minted Proof strata.
